Diagnostic not fully silenced by -Wno-template-body
[ Found while investigatinghttps://gcc.gnu.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=118078]

Consider the following code:

===
template<class T>
struct S {
  S s;
};
==

By default we get both an error and an associated note about S being incomplete at line 3:

===
diag.C:3:5: error: field ‘s’ has incomplete type ‘S<T>’ [-Wtemplate-body]
diag.C:2:8: note: definition of ‘struct S<T>’ is not complete until the closing brace
===

However, when using -Wno-template-body, the error is suppressed as it should, however the note remains, which makes the output puzzing to say the least.

===
diag.C:2:8: note: definition of ‘struct S<T>’ is not complete until the closing brace
===

(seehttps://godbolt.org/z/W13qfz4v8)
